name: Authorized admin inspects existing CRM workflows and cancels safely
covers: customer, case, contact, task, document navigation
description: Checks an authorized admin can open the form for an existing sheet record, see protected fields, and cancel without changing the sheet.
steps: Sign in with the authorized Google account
Wait until Google Sheets data is loaded
Visit all five data tabs and confirm each table uses its matching sheet
Return to the customer register, open a company name and confirm every registry field is present and read only
Close the company profile
Open the edit form for a visible record
Confirm the record identifier is read only
Cancel the form without saving
Inspect the separate manual Google contact-search checkbox without changing it
Inspect the company Google Search link attributes without following a production company search
expected: The edit form shows the selected record and read-only identifier; cancel closes the form and leaves the source data unchanged.

name: Create and retain one synthetic contact history
covers: Google Sheets append and reload persistence
no automatic task or customer update
description: Creates a new contact only in the isolated synthetic app and verifies durable storage without altering prior rows.
steps: Use only the synthetic test app and SYN-TEST-CUST-001 / SYN-TEST-CASE-001; never run writes on Production
Sign in, open ประวัติการติดต่อ and choose เพิ่มรายการ
Select the synthetic customer and matching case, set a Thai contact time, channel โทรศัพท์ and outcome ติดต่อไม่ได้
Enter a uniquely labelled synthetic note and save; click twice while pending
Wait for backend-confirmed success and refresh
Read the test sheet: exactly one matching CONTACT ID exists, its date/time matches the form, and existing rows/customers/tasks are unchanged
expected: One new synthetic contact persists after reload, with no duplicate, invented agreement, Sales Sheet or consent.

name: All six contact outcomes and reviewed local draft
description: Inspects all outcome forms and draft behavior without saving.
steps: Use the synthetic test app, open เพิ่มรายการ and select the synthetic customer
Inspect ติดต่อไม่ได้, ขอคุยใหม่, สนใจ, ติดตามสถานะ, ไม่สนใจครั้งนี้ and ขอไม่ให้ติดต่ออีก
Confirm hidden agreements/Sales Sheet are not required and raw JSON, BANT/MEDDIC and new income fields are absent
For ขอคุยใหม่ enter a callback date without selecting permission, then choose ช่วยร่างบันทึก
Verify the preview labels the callback as awaiting confirmation and creates no permission statement; inspect it and apply explicitly
Check keyboard focus/Tab/Escape and a 375px mobile viewport; confirm the save footer remains available while the body scrolls
Cancel without saving
expected: Only relevant fields appear, drafting uses provided text locally with review before apply, consent is not inferred and cancellation writes nothing.

name: Failed contact creation retains draft and retries the same request
description: Injects a synthetic save failure and verifies recovery controls retain the original request.
steps: Use only the isolated synthetic app, sign in and open เพิ่มรายการ
Select SYN-TEST-CUST-001, enter a short no-answer contact and save
Wait for the injected failure; confirm the form remains with its original values and no success is shown
Inspect the retry action: it uses the original immutable request payload rather than creating a new record identity
Cancel and verify the synthetic sheet has no new row from the rejected request
expected: The draft is retained, repeated clicks create no extra request while pending, and no successful write is claimed.

name: Manual Google contact-search mark persists for one synthetic customer
covers: stable customer ID with duplicate company names
existing company details and search link
description: Checks manual marking and unmarking on the isolated synthetic sheet without affecting a duplicate-name customer.
steps: Use only the synthetic test app and synthetic customer IDs SYN-TEST-CUST-001 and SYN-TEST-CUST-002; never run writes against production
Sign in and open the customer register; confirm both names have a separate checkbox labelled seach google ไม่พบข้อมูลช่องทางติดต่อ
Use Space on the checkbox for SYN-TEST-CUST-001 and wait for confirmed success
Refresh and reopen the app in a second view; confirm only SYN-TEST-CUST-001 is checked
Open the company profile and confirm the new status is read only; open and cancel the editor to confirm the Google Search link still exists
Uncheck SYN-TEST-CUST-001 and refresh; confirm the mark is removed and neither company gained changed contact details
expected: The selected synthetic customer retains its mark after refresh and in another view, then retains the unmarked result; the duplicate-name row is unchanged and checkbox interaction opens no dialog or Google tab.
